ItemID: 1; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a 4K HDMI cable and do not currently need a longer one.
ItemID: 2; Title: Samsung SSD 860 EVO 4TB 2.5 Inch SATA III Internal SSD (MZ-76E4T0B/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A storage upgrade could be useful, but I have no current need for 4TB or confirmed SATA compatibility.
ItemID: 3; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent focus is computer and network accessories, and I am not looking for another streaming device.
ItemID: 4; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current Alexa automation project that would make this useful.
ItemID: 5; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Raspberry Pi setup suggests an interest in entertainment hardware, but I do not currently need a dedicated streaming stick.
ItemID: 6; Title: Amazon Basics 2-Pack USB-A 3.0 Extension Cable, 4.8Gbps High-Speed, Male to Female Gold-Plated Connectors, 6 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these to make desk peripherals easier to reach; USB 3.0 also complements my recent USB Ethernet adapter.
ItemID: 7; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart display does not address the practical computer setup needs reflected in my recent purchases.
ItemID: 8; Title: Cat 6 Ethernet Cable 1 Ft (6Pack), Outdoor&Indoor, 10Gbps Support Cat7 Network, Heavy Duty Flat Internet LAN Patch Cord, Solid High Speed Weatherproof Cable for Router, Modem, Xbox, PS4, Switch, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Short patch cables fit my interest in tidy wired connections, but I would wait until I know my devices are close enough for one-foot cables.
ItemID: 9; Title: TP-Link TL-SG108 | 8 Port Gigabit Unmanaged Ethernet Network Switch, Ethernet Splitter | Plug & Play | Fanless Metal Design | Shielded Ports | Traffic Optimization | Limited Lifetime Protection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this to connect more devices by Ethernet, building on my recent adapter and cable purchases; the fanless design suits a desk setup.
ItemID: 10; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Garmin memory-card purchase does not imply a need for a phone-based Alexa device in the car.
